excerpt: Route 14 carried an average of 11 pupils a day in the autumn term.
scope: Morning runs on Route 14, September to December 2025
authority: Council officers' count from boarding records
limitations: Counts the morning run only; does not count pupils driven to school after the route changed.

excerpt: 23 families said a child used the Route 14 bus on most school days.
scope: Families who answered the survey, January 2026
authority: Self-reported by parents; collected by a parents' group
limitations: Families chose whether to answer; not a census of riders.

excerpt: The contract for Route 14 ended on 31 March and was not renewed.
scope: The cabinet's decision on the Route 14 contract
limitations: Records the decision, not the reasons officers gave for it.

excerpt: We were not invited to tender for a further term of the Route 14 contract.
scope: The operator's account of the contract's end
limitations: One party's account; the council has not replied in the record.

excerpt: Councils must arrange free travel for eligible pupils who live beyond the statutory walking distance.
scope: General duty, not specific to Route 14
limitations: A paraphrase; eligibility depends on distance and circumstances not recorded here.

excerpt: Twelve collisions were recorded on the ring road between 2021 and 2025.
scope: Collisions reported to the police on the ring road, 2021 to 2025
limitations: Says nothing about when safety works will be finished.

excerpt: Correction: Route 14 carried an average of 17 pupils a day in the autumn term; the earlier figure omitted the afternoon run.
scope: Morning and afternoon runs on Route 14, September to December 2025
